verdict.rationale: Mollie's docs say merchants can accept payments in currencies beyond EUR so international customers can pay in their preferred currency, which covers the local-currency charging part of the story. Settlement reports break down payouts by transactions, fees and deductions, but nothing documents settling in the merchant's own currency or how FX conversion rates and costs are shown. Missing for 10: documented conversion and settlement into the merchant's home currency, transparent FX rate/fee disclosure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Mollie enables you to accept payments in currencies beyond EUR through its v2 APIs, allowing international customers to transact in their preferred currency.
It shows all transactions, fees and deductions that are part of a single settlement.
